RCSP-595.feature: Ordering – Credit Requests Damaged Items UOM (Flowers / McLane)
RCSP-595.description: Verify Credit Request damaged-item UOM flows for Flowers and McLane received purchase orders, including positive, negative, and edge scenarios.

prerequisites: Admin user has Ordering > Credit Requests access
At least one Flowers PO in Received status with received items
At least one McLane PO in Received status with received items

flowers.note: Set receivedPoSearch to a Flowers Received PO number/name available in QA

mclane.note: Set receivedPoSearch to a McLane Received PO number/name available in QA

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can navigate from QA Backoffice Dashboard Home page to Ordering menu > Credit Requests page and view the Credit Requests listing for Flowers orders
testCases.description: Verify whether the admin user can navigate from QA Backoffice Dashboard Home page to Ordering menu > Credit Requests page and view the Credit Requests listing for Flowers orders
testCases.preCondition: 1. User has access to QA Backoffice Dashboard URL. 2. Valid admin credentials are available. 3. User has permission to access Ordering > Credit Requests. 4. At least one Flowers Purchase Order exists in Received status with one or more received items.

testSteps.description: Launch the application: QA Backoffice Dashboard.
On the Login page, enter Username and Password, then click Sign In / Login.
Verify the user lands on the Home/Dashboard page after successful login.
From the left/main navigation menu, locate and expand the Ordering menu.
Under the Ordering menu, click on Credit Requests.
Wait for the Credit Requests page to load completely.
Verify the Credit Requests page title/header is displayed.
Verify the + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST button is visible on the Credit Requests page.

testCases.rawTestData: Application: QA Backoffice Dashboard | Username: admin@whataburger-ims.com | Password: admin123 | Menu Path: Ordering > Credit Requests | Order Type: Flowers
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the user successfully navigates to Ordering > Credit Requests page and the Credit Requests listing page loads with the New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST action button visible for Flowers-related credit workflows.

testCases.testName: Verify whether clicking + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST on the Credit Requests page opens the Purchase Order with Received Items search section for Flowers Purchase Orders
testCases.description: Verify whether clicking + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST on the Credit Requests page opens the Purchase Order with Received Items search section for Flowers Purchase Orders
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in to QA Backoffice Dashboard as admin. 2. User is on Ordering > Credit Requests page. 3. A Flowers Purchase Order in Received status with at least one received item exists.

testSteps.description: On the Credit Requests page under Ordering menu, locate the + New Credit Request or START CREDIT REQUEST button.
Click the + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST button.
Wait for the New Credit Request selection screen/modal to load.
Verify the Purchase Order with Received Items search field is displayed.
Verify the user can search/select a Purchase Order from the search field.
Verify the Start Credit Request button is visible (enabled only after a valid PO selection as applicable).

testCases.rawTestData: Menu Path: Ordering > Credit Requests | Action: + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST | PO Type: Flowers | PO Status: Received
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the New Credit Request flow displays the Purchase Order with Received Items search field so the user can select a Flowers Purchase Order in Received status before starting the credit request.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 1: Create Credit Request
testCases.testName: Verify whether selecting a Flowers Purchase Order in Received status from the Purchase Order with Received Items search field and clicking Start Credit Request navigates the user to the Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.description: Verify whether selecting a Flowers Purchase Order in Received status from the Purchase Order with Received Items search field and clicking Start Credit Request navigates the user to the Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User is on Ordering > Credit Requests > New Credit Request selection screen. 3. A Flowers Purchase Order (PO) exists in Received status. 4. The Flowers PO contains at least one received item.

testSteps.description: Launch QA Backoffice Dashboard and login with valid admin credentials.
Expand the Ordering menu and click Credit Requests.
Click + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST button.
In the Purchase Order with Received Items search field, search for the prerequisite Flowers Purchase Order that is in Received status.
Select the Flowers Purchase Order from the search results.
Click the Start Credit Request button.
Wait for navigation to complete.
Verify the page title/header shows Damaged Items From Order.
Verify the selected Flowers PO details and received item list are displayed on the Damaged Items From Order page.

testCases.rawTestData: Username: admin@whataburger-ims.com | Password: admin123 | PO Type: Flowers | PO Status: Received | Page: Damaged Items From Order
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether after selecting a Received Flowers Purchase Order and clicking Start Credit Request, the user lands on the Damaged Items From Order page with the selected PO's received items listed.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 2: Display Damaged Item Fields
testCases.testName: Verify whether selecting the Damaged checkbox for a received item on the Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers) displays all mandatory damaged-item fields: Incident Type, Qty, UOM, Can you use this product?, Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit?, and Images
testCases.description: Verify whether selecting the Damaged checkbox for a received item on the Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers) displays all mandatory damaged-item fields: Incident Type, Qty, UOM, Can you use this product?, Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit?, and Images
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User has started a Credit Request for a Flowers PO in Received status. 3. User is on the Damaged Items From Order page. 4. At least one received item is listed from the Flowers PO.

testSteps.description: On the Damaged Items From Order page for the Flowers Credit Request, locate a received item row in the items section.
Select/check the Damaged checkbox for that item.
Observe the fields that appear for the selected damaged item.
Verify field Incident Type * is displayed and marked mandatory.
Verify field Qty * is displayed and marked mandatory.
Verify field UOM * is displayed and marked mandatory.
Verify field Can you use this product? * is displayed and marked mandatory.
Verify field Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * is displayed and marked mandatory.
Verify field Images * is displayed and marked mandatory (as applicable per business rules).
Verify all listed fields are editable at this Draft stage.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Page: Damaged Items From Order | Action: Select Damaged checkbox | Expected Fields: Incident Type *, Qty *, UOM *, Can you use this product? *, Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? *, Images *
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether selecting the Damaged checkbox on the Damaged Items From Order page for a Flowers Credit Request displays all required damaged-item fields (Incident Type, Qty, UOM, Can you use this product?, enough good product / IUT question, and Images) as mandatory.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 3: Validate UOM Values
testCases.testName: Verify whether the UOM dropdown values displayed for a damaged item on the Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers Credit Request) match the UOM configuration defined for the same item in Inventory Setup > Item Master
testCases.description: Verify whether the UOM dropdown values displayed for a damaged item on the Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers Credit Request) match the UOM configuration defined for the same item in Inventory Setup > Item Master
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Prerequisite item exists on a Flowers Received PO and also exists in Inventory Setup > Item Master with configured UOM values. 3. User is on Damaged Items From Order page for the Flowers Credit Request. 4. Damaged checkbox is selected for the prerequisite item.

testSteps.description: Note the Item Code/Name of the prerequisite item on the Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers).
Select the Damaged checkbox for that item if not already selected.
Click/open the UOM * dropdown for the damaged item and record all available UOM values.
Navigate to Inventory Setup > Item Master (open in another tab or after noting values).
Search for the same prerequisite item in Item Master.
Open the item details and record the configured UOM values for the item.
Navigate back to Ordering > Credit Requests > Damaged Items From Order (Flowers Credit Request Draft).
Compare the UOM dropdown values on Credit Request with Item Master UOM configuration.
Verify every UOM option in Credit Request exists in Item Master.
Verify no extra/invalid UOM option appears in Credit Request that is not in Item Master.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Page: Damaged Items From Order | Section: Damaged Item Fields > UOM * | Comparison Source: Inventory Setup > Item Master | Item: <Prerequisite Item from Flowers PO>
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the UOM dropdown values on the Flowers Credit Request Damaged Items From Order page exactly match the UOM configuration for the same item in Inventory Setup > Item Master.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 4: Validate UOM Profile
testCases.testName: Verify whether the UOM profile for a damaged item on the Flowers Credit Request matches the item's Stock Count configuration (Daily / Weekly / Monthly) as configured in Inventory Setup for the same prerequisite item
testCases.description: Verify whether the UOM profile for a damaged item on the Flowers Credit Request matches the item's Stock Count configuration (Daily / Weekly / Monthly) as configured in Inventory Setup for the same prerequisite item
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Prerequisite item exists on Flowers Received PO. 3. Same item has Stock Count configuration set to Daily or Weekly or Monthly in Inventory Setup. 4. User has started a Credit Request for the Flowers PO and selected Damaged for the item.

testSteps.description: Navigate to Inventory Setup and open the Stock Count configuration (Daily / Weekly / Monthly) for the prerequisite item; record the Stock Count frequency and associated UOM profile.
Navigate to Ordering > Credit Requests and open/create the Flowers Credit Request for the Received PO containing the same item.
On Damaged Items From Order page, select Damaged checkbox for the prerequisite item.
Observe the default/selected UOM and UOM profile behavior for the item.
Compare the Credit Request UOM profile with the Stock Count UOM profile recorded from Inventory Setup.
Verify the UOM profile on Credit Request matches Stock Count configuration (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) for that item.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Item: <Prerequisite Item> | Stock Count Path: Inventory Setup > Stock Count (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) | Credit Request Path: Ordering > Credit Requests > Damaged Items From Order
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the UOM profile on the Flowers Credit Request for the damaged item matches the Stock Count (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) UOM profile configured for the same item in Inventory Setup.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 5: Update UOM Before Submission
testCases.testName: Verify whether the user can change/update the UOM dropdown value on a Draft Flowers Credit Request on the Damaged Items From Order page, save successfully, and see the updated UOM reflected when the Draft is reopened
testCases.description: Verify whether the user can change/update the UOM dropdown value on a Draft Flowers Credit Request on the Damaged Items From Order page, save successfully, and see the updated UOM reflected when the Draft is reopened
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. A Flowers Credit Request exists in Draft status. 3. Damaged checkbox is selected for an item with multiple UOM options available. 4. User is on Damaged Items From Order page for the Draft Credit Request.

testSteps.description: Open the Draft Flowers Credit Request from Ordering > Credit Requests listing (Draft section/filter if available).
On Damaged Items From Order page, locate the UOM * dropdown for the damaged item.
Note the currently selected UOM value.
Change the UOM dropdown to a different valid UOM value from the list.
Complete any other mandatory damaged fields if not already filled (Incident Type, Qty, Can you use this product?, enough good product/IUT, Images as applicable).
Click Save (or Save Draft / equivalent save action) on the Credit Request.
Verify a success confirmation is displayed and status remains Draft.
Navigate away from the Damaged Items From Order page back to Credit Requests listing.
Reopen the same Draft Credit Request.
Verify the UOM dropdown shows the updated UOM value that was saved.
Verify Draft record values reflect the updated UOM.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Status: Draft | Page: Damaged Items From Order | Field: UOM * | Action: Change UOM > Save > Reopen Draft
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether updating the UOM dropdown on a Draft Flowers Credit Request saves successfully, Draft record values update with the new UOM, and the updated UOM persists when the Draft Credit Request is reopened.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 6: Submit Credit Request
testCases.testName: Verify whether the user can submit a Draft Flowers Credit Request from the Damaged Items From Order page with all mandatory damaged fields completed including the selected UOM, and the Credit Request status changes to Submitted
testCases.description: Verify whether the user can submit a Draft Flowers Credit Request from the Damaged Items From Order page with all mandatory damaged fields completed including the selected UOM, and the Credit Request status changes to Submitted
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. A Flowers Credit Request exists in Draft status with Damaged item fields completed including a selected UOM. 3. All mandatory fields are valid.

testSteps.description: Open the Draft Flowers Credit Request from Ordering > Credit Requests.
On Damaged Items From Order page, verify Damaged checkbox is selected.
Verify Incident Type * is filled.
Verify Qty * is filled with a valid quantity.
Verify UOM * has the intended UOM value selected.
Verify Can you use this product? * is answered.
Verify Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * is answered.
Verify Images * has required image(s) uploaded (if applicable).
Click Submit / Submit Credit Request button.
Wait for submission to complete.
Verify success confirmation is displayed.
On Credit Requests listing, locate the Credit Request by ID.
Verify status is Submitted (or equivalent submitted status).

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Status Before: Draft | Status After: Submitted | Page: Damaged Items From Order | UOM: <selected UOM value>
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether submitting a fully completed Draft Flowers Credit Request succeeds and the Credit Request is saved in Submitted status with the selected UOM value retained.

testCases.module: Ordering > Credit Requests (Flowers) ‚Äî Scenario 7: Restrict UOM Updates After Submission
testCases.testName: Verify whether the UOM field on a Submitted Flowers Credit Request is read-only on the Damaged Items From Order / Credit Request details page and the user cannot change or update the UOM value after submission
testCases.description: Verify whether the UOM field on a Submitted Flowers Credit Request is read-only on the Damaged Items From Order / Credit Request details page and the user cannot change or update the UOM value after submission
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. A Flowers Credit Request has been submitted successfully (from TC_CR_FLW_POS_006). 3. User can open the submitted Credit Request from Ordering > Credit Requests.

testSteps.description: Navigate to Ordering > Credit Requests.
Locate and open the Submitted Flowers Credit Request.
Navigate to the Damaged Items From Order / submitted details section for the damaged item.
Locate the UOM field for the damaged item.
Verify the UOM field is displayed as read-only / disabled / non-editable.
Attempt to click the UOM dropdown or change the UOM value.
Verify the UOM value cannot be modified.
Verify no Save action updates UOM for the submitted record.
Verify the submitted UOM value remains unchanged and matches the value at submission time.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Status: Submitted | Page: Credit Request Details / Damaged Items From Order | Field: UOM | Expected Behavior: Read-only
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether after submission of a Flowers Credit Request the UOM field is read-only, the user cannot change the UOM, and the submitted UOM value remains unchanged.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the Start Credit Request button does not navigate to Damaged Items From Order page when no Flowers Purchase Order is selected in the Purchase Order with Received Items search field
testCases.description: Verify whether the Start Credit Request button does not navigate to Damaged Items From Order page when no Flowers Purchase Order is selected in the Purchase Order with Received Items search field
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User is on Ordering > Credit Requests > New Credit Request selection screen.

testSteps.description: Expand Ordering menu and click Credit Requests.
Click + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST.
Do NOT select any Purchase Order in the Purchase Order with Received Items search field.
Attempt to click Start Credit Request.
Observe validation/error behavior.
Verify the user does not land on Damaged Items From Order page.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | PO Selection: (none) | Action: Start Credit Request
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the system blocks Start Credit Request and displays a validation message requiring Purchase Order selection when no Flowers PO is selected.

testCases.testName: Verify whether a Flowers Purchase Order that is NOT in Received status does not appear as selectable (or cannot be used) in the Purchase Order with Received Items search field for creating a Credit Request
testCases.description: Verify whether a Flowers Purchase Order that is NOT in Received status does not appear as selectable (or cannot be used) in the Purchase Order with Received Items search field for creating a Credit Request
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. A Flowers Purchase Order exists in a non-Received status (e.g., Open, In Transit, Cancelled, or Draft ‚Äî as applicable). 3. User is on New Credit Request PO search screen.

testSteps.description: Navigate to Ordering > Credit Requests and click + New Credit Request / START CREDIT REQUEST.
In Purchase Order with Received Items search field, search for the Flowers PO that is not in Received status.
Observe whether the non-Received PO appears in search results.
If it appears, attempt to select it and click Start Credit Request.
Verify the system does not allow creating a Credit Request from a non-Received Flowers PO.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | PO Status: Not Received (Open/In Transit/Cancelled/etc.) | Search Field: Purchase Order with Received Items
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether only Flowers Purchase Orders in Received status are eligible for Credit Request creation and non-Received POs cannot be started as Credit Requests.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the mandatory damaged-item fields (Incident Type, Qty, UOM, Can you use this product?, enough good product/IUT, Images) do NOT appear on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers) when the Damaged checkbox is not selected
testCases.description: Verify whether the mandatory damaged-item fields (Incident Type, Qty, UOM, Can you use this product?, enough good product/IUT, Images) do NOT appear on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers) when the Damaged checkbox is not selected
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User is on Damaged Items From Order page for a Flowers Credit Request. 3. Damaged checkbox is unchecked for the item.

testSteps.description: Open Damaged Items From Order page for Flowers Credit Request.
Ensure Damaged checkbox for the item is NOT selected.
Observe the item row/section.
Verify Incident Type * is not displayed.
Verify Qty * is not displayed.
Verify UOM * is not displayed.
Verify Can you use this product? * is not displayed.
Verify Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * is not displayed.
Verify Images * is not displayed.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Page: Damaged Items From Order | Damaged Checkbox: Unchecked
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether damaged-item mandatory fields remain hidden on the Flowers Damaged Items From Order page until the Damaged checkbox is selected.

testCases.testName: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Damaged checkbox is selected but Incident Type * is left blank on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.description: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Damaged checkbox is selected but Incident Type * is left blank on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User is on Damaged Items From Order page for Flowers Credit Request. 3. Damaged checkbox is selected.

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox for an item.
Leave Incident Type * blank.
Fill Qty *, UOM *, Can you use this product? *, enough good product/IUT *, and Images * with valid data.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe validation message on Incident Type *.
Verify Credit Request is not submitted.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: Incident Type * | Value: (blank)
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the system displays mandatory validation for Incident Type * and prevents save/submit of the Flowers Credit Request when Incident Type is empty.

testCases.testName: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Qty * is left blank or invalid after selecting Damaged on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.description: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Qty * is left blank or invalid after selecting Damaged on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Damaged checkbox is selected for a Flowers item on Damaged Items From Order page.

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox.
Fill Incident Type * with a valid value.
Leave Qty * blank (or enter invalid value 0 / negative as separate observation).
Select a valid UOM *.
Fill remaining mandatory fields.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe Qty * field validation.
Verify Credit Request is not submitted with blank/invalid Qty.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: Qty * | Invalid Data: blank / 0 / negative
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether Qty * mandatory/validity rules block save/submit of the Flowers Credit Request when quantity is blank, zero, or negative.

testCases.testName: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when UOM * is not selected after Damaged checkbox is selected on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.description: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when UOM * is not selected after Damaged checkbox is selected on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Damaged checkbox is selected on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers).

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox for an item.
Fill Incident Type * and Qty * with valid values.
Leave UOM * unselected/blank.
Fill Can you use this product? *, enough good product/IUT *, and Images *.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe UOM * validation.
Verify Credit Request is not submitted.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: UOM * | Value: (blank)
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether UOM * mandatory validation blocks save/submit of the Flowers Credit Request when UOM is not selected.

testCases.testName: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Can you use this product? * is left unanswered after Damaged is selected
testCases.description: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Can you use this product? * is left unanswered after Damaged is selected
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Damaged checkbox is selected on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers).

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox.
Fill Incident Type *, Qty *, and UOM *.
Leave Can you use this product? * unanswered.
Fill enough good product/IUT * and Images *.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe mandatory validation on Can you use this product? *.
Verify Credit Request is not submitted.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: Can you use this product? * | Value: (blank)
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether Can you use this product? * mandatory validation blocks save/submit of the Flowers Credit Request when the field is unanswered.

testCases.testName: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * is left unanswered after Damaged is selected
testCases.description: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * is left unanswered after Damaged is selected
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Damaged checkbox is selected on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers).

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox.
Fill Incident Type *, Qty *, UOM *, and Can you use this product? *.
Leave Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * unanswered.
Upload Images * if required.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe mandatory validation on the enough good product / IUT field.
Verify Credit Request is not submitted.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: Do you have enough good product until your next delivery? / Can you IUT from another unit? * | Value: (blank)
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the enough good product / IUT mandatory field validation blocks save/submit of the Flowers Credit Request when unanswered.

testCases.testName: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Images * are not uploaded (when Images are mandatory per business rules) after Damaged is selected on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.description: Verify whether saving/submitting a Flowers Credit Request is blocked when Images * are not uploaded (when Images are mandatory per business rules) after Damaged is selected on Damaged Items From Order page
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Damaged checkbox is selected. 3. Business rule requires Images as mandatory for damaged credit items.

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox for a Flowers item.
Fill all other mandatory fields: Incident Type *, Qty *, UOM *, Can you use this product? *, enough good product/IUT *.
Do NOT upload any image under Images *.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe Images * validation message.
Verify Credit Request is not submitted without required images.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: Images * | Value: (no upload)
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether Images * mandatory validation (when applicable) blocks save/submit of the Flowers Credit Request when no image is uploaded.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the user cannot modify the UOM value on a Submitted Flowers Credit Request and any attempted edit does not update the Draft/submitted record values
testCases.description: Verify whether the user cannot modify the UOM value on a Submitted Flowers Credit Request and any attempted edit does not update the Draft/submitted record values
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Flowers Credit Request is in Submitted status.

testSteps.description: Open the Submitted Flowers Credit Request from Ordering > Credit Requests.
Attempt to change the UOM field (click, keyboard, inspect if editable).
If any Save button is visible, attempt to save after trying to change UOM.
Refresh/reopen the Submitted Credit Request.
Verify UOM value is unchanged from the submitted value.
Verify no Draft-style editable UOM update is allowed on Submitted records.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Status: Submitted | Field: UOM
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether Submitted Flowers Credit Requests lock UOM and do not allow UOM updates that would change the submitted record values.

testCases.testName: Verify whether unchecking the Damaged checkbox on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers) hides the damaged-item fields again and clears or discards incomplete damaged field entries as per application behavior
testCases.description: Verify whether unchecking the Damaged checkbox on Damaged Items From Order page (Flowers) hides the damaged-item fields again and clears or discards incomplete damaged field entries as per application behavior
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User is on Damaged Items From Order page for Flowers. 3. Damaged checkbox was previously selected and fields were displayed.

testSteps.description: Select Damaged checkbox and observe fields appear.
Optionally enter partial data in Qty and Incident Type.
Uncheck the Damaged checkbox.
Verify damaged fields are hidden.
Re-select Damaged checkbox.
Observe whether previously entered values are cleared or retained per designed behavior.
Document actual behavior against expected product rule.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Action: Uncheck Damaged checkbox
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether unchecking Damaged on Flowers Damaged Items From Order page hides the damaged fields and follows the expected clear/retain behavior for previously entered values.

testCases.testName: Verify whether Qty entered on Flowers Damaged Items From Order page cannot exceed the received quantity of the item on the Flowers Purchase Order (or system validates against received qty per business rules)
testCases.description: Verify whether Qty entered on Flowers Damaged Items From Order page cannot exceed the received quantity of the item on the Flowers Purchase Order (or system validates against received qty per business rules)
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. Flowers Received PO has a known received quantity for the prerequisite item. 3. User is on Damaged Items From Order page with Damaged selected.

testSteps.description: Note the received quantity of the item from the Flowers PO / Damaged Items From Order page.
Select Damaged checkbox.
Enter Qty * greater than the received quantity.
Select valid UOM and complete other mandatory fields.
Click Save and/or Submit.
Observe whether system blocks with validation that Qty cannot exceed received quantity.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Field: Qty * | Test Data: Received Qty + 1
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the system validates damaged Qty against the Flowers PO received quantity and blocks invalid over-quantity credit requests (per business rules).

testCases.testName: Verify whether changing UOM on a Draft Flowers Credit Request updates only the Draft record and does not affect already Submitted Credit Requests for the same or different Flowers PO
testCases.description: Verify whether changing UOM on a Draft Flowers Credit Request updates only the Draft record and does not affect already Submitted Credit Requests for the same or different Flowers PO
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. One Draft Flowers Credit Request and one Submitted Flowers Credit Request exist.

testSteps.description: Open the Submitted Flowers Credit Request and record its UOM value.
Open the Draft Flowers Credit Request and change UOM to a different valid value.
Save the Draft Credit Request.
Reopen the Submitted Credit Request.
Verify Submitted UOM is unchanged.
Reopen Draft and verify updated UOM is retained.

testCases.rawTestData: Order Type: Flowers | Draft UOM: Updated | Submitted UOM: Unchanged
